purpose: Preserve V173's quota-one and cheap-terminal gains while preventing speculation on a cheap terminal whose unfinished workflow remains far from completion, by prioritizing the smallest current SRPT request remaining-work proxy before terminal CPU work.

paper_sequence_gate.homogeneous_middle_and_high_historical_b: retain unchanged and do not rerun

causal_diagnosis.supported: V173 certified the least-CPU choice in every active window and improved throughput on four selected seeds versus V172, but total QPR fell. The dominant E01 regression combined a 38% queue-area increase with lower throughput and higher latency and cost. Terminal CPU alone measures immediate speculative cost, not how close the owning workflow is to producing a completion. The scheduler already defines a policy-independent current request remaining-work proxy from unfinished configured CPU, cold-start and transfer work for SRPT; using it first targets completion proximity without outcome or label leakage.
